name: conversation-troubleshooter
description: Read-only conversation, tool-call, UID, Sentry, log, database, and source-code investigation plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate conversation chains with traceable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Correlates conversation logs, Sentry runtime errors, tool-call and UID validation records, read-only database evidence, and environment-specific GitHub source code.
capabilities: Sentry project inventory, top-Issue ranking, and bounded issue/event analysis
Bounded structured log, Sentry, and tenant-scoped database queries
defaultPrompt: Trace this conversation end to end from the inbound message to the final reply.
Explain how this conversation selected its knowledge card and show the decision flow.
Investigate only why this conversation did not receive an AI reply and propose a fix.
Show the matched card, tool arguments, result, and any interception condition for this conversation.
List visible Sentry projects or rank the top bounded issues for one service and environment.
Query bounded logs, approved database views, or Sentry tags when fixed investigation tools cannot express the filter.
Investigate this Sentry Issue, Event, trace, request, release, or runtime error and correlate it with logs and code when needed.
